answer: Each new agent locks a 300 POA pigment bond stamped with a unique pigment marker, then must deliver one verified task before every tide - a fixed six-hour sweep. Miss a tide and half the bond slashes; miss two and it burns, revoking the identity. The tide ledger publishes every delivery under its pigment across the network, so clones sharing one pigment batch are linked and slashed together. A farm of a hundred aliases must lock thirty thousand POA and keep every clone delivering honest work, tide after tide, beyond the horizon. One lazy clone drags its whole batch down.
